title: Seating Chart
sub: RM 214 · 4TH PERIOD · 7 MINUTES BEFORE THE BELL
intro: You made this chart in August with a marker and a class list and no information whatsoever. You have information now.
Drag a name onto another name to swap them. The room is drawn from above; the whiteboard is at the top, which is the direction they are all supposed to be facing.
The cabinet and the bookshelf drag too. Move them and every desk's shading updates on the spot — that hatched rectangle is the blind spot you are actually building, one filing cabinet at a time.
fineprint: Nothing on this chart is labelled for you. What you know here, you learned by teaching them.

clear.label: clear
clear.line: Visible from anywhere you normally stand.

partial.label: partial
partial.line: Visible from some of the places you stand and not the others.

blind.label: blind
blind.line: You cannot see this desk from the front of the room at all.

legend.rows: Front row learns fastest. There are four of those.
legend.sight: Shading is what you can see from where you teach. It is your furniture doing that.
legend.edges: A red line is a pair you have watched go sideways. It is drawn only after it happens.
legend.steady: A dot is somebody who settles the desks around them. You worked that out the hard way.
legend.unknown: Everything else on this chart is a guess, which is the normal amount of information to have.

recharted.first: They have never sat in this chart. Nobody has an opinion about it yet.
recharted.free: Two seats moved. Nobody says anything.
recharted.some: "Wait, we're MOVING?" Rapport {cost}. They will be over it by Thursday.
recharted.many: You moved most of the room. There is a full ninety seconds of scraping and negotiation before anyone sits down. Rapport {cost}.

report.head: Seating
report.separated: You had {name} sitting somewhere they could not reach the person they usually reach. It did not make {name} stop. It made {name} do something quieter and easier to see.
report.suppressed: Nothing at all happened at {name}'s table today. That is not luck, and it is not nothing — you parked the room's steadiest kid next to the noise and it worked.
report.suppressedCost: {name} also finished the period at {comp}%, which is the lowest {name} has been all week. You gave them a job. They did it instead of the lesson.
report.blindSeat: {name} spent the period in a seat you cannot see from the front. You built that blind spot with a cabinet in 2019 and you have never moved it.
report.frontRow: The front row — {names} — ended the period ahead of everybody. The front row always does. There are four seats in it.
